name: tia_import_scl_block
description: Import a complete SCL block source string; the server creates the temporary .scl file. Existing same-name blocks are backed up, deleted, and replaced; failed imports attempt to restore the backup.

compile_after_import.description: Compile the target PLC after import (default true). Compilation errors are reported and do not roll back the imported block.

folder.description: Target block group path (optional; an existing block's group is preserved when omitted).

open_after_import.description: Open the imported block in the TIA Portal editor after import (default false).

plc_name.description: Name of the target PLC (optional, defaults to first PLC).

scl_code.description: Complete SCL source for exactly one FUNCTION, FUNCTION_BLOCK, ORGANIZATION_BLOCK, or DATA_BLOCK.
